ladder.scale_out: Take 50% @ T1 → stop to breakeven → run 50% to T2

duration.valid_until: expected ~4 days, valid up to ~10 days

time_stop.note: If neither stop nor target fills within ~10 days, the thesis has expired — exit at market.

entries.label: Now · market
entries.plain: Take it now at market — fastest fill, but the worst price of the three. Price is already extended from value (medium chase).

decision.reason: Short Mean Reversion into a strong bullish tape (100.0); higher-TF bullish with no turn confirmation. Knife-catch — stand aside; the long is the tape-aligned trade.
